DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL).

The clinical presentation of significant weight loss, lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, and monoclonal B lymphocytes on flow cytometry is diagnostic for CLL. Do you have any history of recurrent infections or autoimmune conditions?
